bio_en: Garnik Ter-Tadevosian, known as Garnik Bidza ('uncle'), was the overseer of the fields, vineyards and estates of the Etchmiadzin monastery, respected in the villages as a people's judge and peacemaker. Expelled from the Etchmiadzin seminary after a student revolt, he became an ARF activist. He was involved in party work during the 1903 seizure of the Armenian church properties. The memoirist, who worked with him for five years in Etchmiadzin from 1915, describes him as a colourful local leader.
